title: Rava bar Zutra
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 14:4: “Rabbi Yonah, Rabbi Ze’ira, Rava bar Zutra, Rabbi Chanina in the name of Rabbi: One may raise the ears on Shabbat.” In the Babylonian Talmud, Avodah Zarah 28b: “Rabbah bar Zutra said that Rabbi Chanina said: One may raise the ears on Shabbat.” Hyman identifies these Rava and Rabbah forms as one person, whom he identifies as Rabbi Abba, and proposes Rabbi Ba in the Jerusalem Talmud.

notes.text: The identification of Rava, Rabbah and Rabbi Abba, and the proposed Rabbi Ba reading, are Hyman’s connected claims. No authority merge or independent proof of identity is asserted.
